summary.headline: Jupiter Enters Leo and Virgo
summary.text: Astrological weather, health, agricultural, and political omens for Cancer and for Jupiter’s entry into Leo, citing Democritus, Tara, Taj al-Din Akram, Buzarjmehr Ibn Bakhtagan, Hermes, and Ahmad Abd al-Jalil. The passage begins the predictions for Jupiter’s entry into Virgo, including pure air, healthy creatures, safe ships, and peace.
